tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows mild leukopenia, anemia (low hemoglobin, MCHC), and thrombocytopenia, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or chronic disease. Lipid profile is atherogenic (high total cholesterol, LDL, triglycerides; low HDL). HbA1c is mildly elevated, indicating impaired glucose metabolism. Renal and liver function, electrolytes, and coagulation are within normal limits. Recommend clinical correlation for cytopenias and cardiovascular/metabolic risk management.
